targets.label: 05.3.3 Repair, installation and hire of household appliances (S)
07.3.2.2 Passenger transport by taxi and hired vehicle with driver (S)

rules.definition: Passenger taxi fares or hired vehicles with a driver; excludes self-drive rental.
rules.reason: The synthetic taxonomy defines this as passenger taxi transport.

rules.definition: Itemized retail food and non-alcoholic beverages only, excluding household goods and serving services.
rules.reason: Requires this explicit semantic category; a broad grocery label is insufficient.

rules.definition: Repair, installation or hire of household appliances only, excluding other repair work.
rules.reason: Requires identification of the household-appliance service.

rules.definition: Food and beverage serving services only, with no claim about restaurant versus canteen subcategory.
rules.reason: The broad serving-service category cannot be assigned to a child category without more information.

rules.definition: Restaurant, cafe and similar food/beverage serving services, excluding retail groceries and canteens.
rules.reason: Requires an explicit restaurant/cafe serving-service category.

rules.definition: Canteen, cafeteria and refectory serving services, explicitly distinguished from restaurant/cafe services.
Broad grocery purchase without item-level food, alcohol and nonfood separation.
rules.reason: Itemization or correction is needed before identifying food and non-alcoholic beverages.

rules.definition: Broad dining label without confirmed serving-service or subcategory coverage.
rules.reason: A dining label alone does not establish an exact survey service concept.

rules.definition: Coffee purchase without confirmed retail versus served-drink classification.
rules.reason: Retail coffee and cafe serving services belong to different statistical groups.

rules.definition: Unspecified repair work; the repaired object is not established.
rules.reason: An unspecified repair cannot automatically become a household-appliance repair.

rules.definition: Housing costs, outside the groups in this pinned expenditure snapshot.
rules.reason: The selected snapshot groups do not cover housing; excluded money remains visible.

rules.definition: An account movement rather than a consumption category.
rules.reason: Transfers are not survey consumption. Economic-flow classification remains authoritative.

limitations: This is an application-authored crosswalk for the named synthetic taxonomy, not an official Statistics Finland or organizer mapping.
Unknown taxonomies and unknown categories remain unmapped; names alone never grant compatibility.
The three coaching baskets describe necessity and recurrence, not COICOP categories; basket and merchant text do not select a mapping.
Ambiguous candidates are possible destinations, not allocations. No ambiguous amount is split or assigned automatically.
Parent and child target groups overlap and cannot be selected together for a summed mapping. A parent amount cannot be distributed to children.
Mapping does not establish household completeness, compatible price/year periods or a valid personal population comparison.
